decisions.reason: As a pharmaceutical tablet in a therapeutic area the firm can likely understand and refine, it fits existing formulation and regulatory knowledge, and its own product page suggests a meaningful launch commitment despite the niche market.

A generic antidepressant capsule is very close to the firm's core absorptive base in generics and solid-dose manufacturing, so management would usually keep it unless early commercial results were clearly poor, which the website signal does not indicate.

A combination antihypertensive film tablet strongly leverages established pharmaceutical know-how and chronic-care market experience, and the dedicated page points to a serious commercialization effort that the firm is likely to continue learning from.

A bone and joint dietary supplement is more weakly tied to the firm's core pharmaceutical knowledge base and was only mentioned rather than fully presented, so management would be more likely to redeploy resources away from it.
